{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the conversion
print('Revenue converted successfully?')
print(sales_df['revenue'].dtype)

# Check if refunded orders are included in the conversion metric
print('\nConversion rate overall:')
print(sales_df['converted'].mean())

# Focus on NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
# Filter: channel == 'paid_search' AND customer_segment == 'new'
paid_search_new = sales_df[(sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check the size of this group
print('\nNumber of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH:')
print(len(paid_search_new))

# Compute conversion rate for this group
conversion_rate = paid_search_new['converted'].mean()

print(f'\nConversion rate for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {conversion_rate}')

# Return the fraction
conversion_rate"}
